content.text:
I made some conservative improvements to `0.html` that keep the look the same: a 400px black circle centred on the page. I haven't opened it in a browser to check.

- **No stray scrollbars:** the body no longer uses `width: 100vw`, and its fixed `height: 100vh` is now a `min-height` with a `100dvh` fallback pair, so mobile browser toolbars don't clip the centring.
- **Scales on small screens:** the circle now shrinks to fit viewports narrower or shorter than 400px instead of being cut off, and stays square.
- **Accessible:** the SVG has `role="img"` and a `<title>` of "Black circle", so screen readers announce it. Hovering the circle will also show that text as a tooltip.
- **Layout tidy-ups:** I added `box-sizing: border-box` to the reset and `display: block` on the SVG.

I left the page title and the SVG id as `ae683f770`, since they look generated and something else may reference them.

"Improve" was open-ended, so I stopped short of anything that changes the design, such as colours, dark-mode support, animation, or a descriptive page title.
